+import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffExtraction
+import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorIdealSheaf
+
+/-!
+# The intrinsic ideal sheaf of a local-equation divisor
+
+On a proper relative curve, the germwise section ideals of a local-equation system satisfy
+basic-open localization.  They therefore define an ideal sheaf independently of the affine
+adaptation used to prove this fact.  The resulting ideal sheaf is invariant under `DivEq` and
+agrees with the previously constructed ideal of every widened affine adaptation.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
+
+universe u
+
+open CategoryTheory Opposite TopologicalSpace
+
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry
+
+namespace Scheme.LocalEquations
+
+variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
+
+/-- Restricting sections sends the germwise section ideal into the section ideal on the
+smaller open. -/
+theorem map_sectionIdeal_le (d : X.LocalEquations) {U V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) :
+    Ideal.map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom (d.sectionIdeal U) ≤
+      d.sectionIdeal V := by
+  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
+  intro s hs
+  rw [Ideal.mem_comap]
+  intro z hz
+  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
+  exact hs z (h hz)
+
+/-- Divisor equality preserves the germwise ideal of sections on every open. -/
+theorem sectionIdeal_eq_of_divEq {d₁ d₂ : X.LocalEquations} (h : d₁.DivEq d₂)
+    (U : X.Opens) : d₁.sectionIdeal U = d₂.sectionIdeal U := by
+  ext s
+  simp only [mem_sectionIdeal_iff]
+  constructor
+  · intro hs z hz
+    rw [← stalkIdeal_eq_of_divEq h z]
+    exact hs z hz
+  · intro hs z hz
+    rw [stalkIdeal_eq_of_divEq h z]
+    exact hs z hz
+
+end Scheme.LocalEquations
+
+attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
+
+variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
+variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
+variable {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
+
+namespace AffAdaptation
+
+/-- On every affine subopen of an adapted piece, the intrinsic section ideal is generated by
+the restriction of the adapted equation. -/
+theorem sectionIdeal_eq_span_restrict_eqn (A : AffAdaptation D d) (j : D.index)
+    {U : (relCurve C R).Opens} (hU : U ≤ D.pieces j) :
+    d.sectionIdeal U = Ideal.span {
+      ((relCurve C R).presheaf.map (homOfLE hU).op).hom (A.eqn j)} := by
+  apply d.sectionIdeal_eq_span_of_generator
+  · intro z hz
+    rw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
+    exact A.eqn_regular j z (hU hz)
+  · intro z hz
+    rw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
+    exact A.germ_eqn_span_eq_stalkIdeal j (hU hz)
+
+/-- The Cartier ideal of an adaptation agrees with the intrinsic section ideal on every
+affine subopen of one adapted piece. -/
+theorem cartierIdeal_ideal_eq_sectionIdeal_of_le [IsProper C.hom]
+    (A : AffAdaptation D d) (j : D.index) (U : (relCurve C R).affineOpens)
+    (hU : U.1 ≤ D.pieces j) :
+    A.cartierIdeal.ideal U = d.sectionIdeal U.1 := by
+  rw [← A.cartierIdeal.map_ideal (U := U)
+    (V := ⟨D.pieces j, D.isAffineOpen j⟩) hU]
+  rw [A.cartierIdeal_ideal_eq_span_eqn j, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
+  exact (A.sectionIdeal_eq_span_restrict_eqn j hU).symm
+
+/-- The Cartier ideal of any widened adaptation is the germwise section ideal on every
+affine open of the relative curve. -/
+theorem cartierIdeal_ideal_eq_sectionIdeal_affine [IsProper C.hom]
+    (A : AffAdaptation D d) (U : (relCurve C R).affineOpens) :
+    A.cartierIdeal.ideal U = d.sectionIdeal U.1 := by
+  apply le_antisymm
+  · intro s hs z hz
+    obtain ⟨j, hzj⟩ := D.exists_mem_pieces z
+    let W : (relCurve C R).affineOpens :=
+      ⟨U.1 ⊓ D.pieces j, Over.isAffineOpen_inf C U.2 (D.isAffineOpen j)⟩
+    have hsW :
+        ((relCurve C R).presheaf.map
+          (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W.1 ≤ U.1)).op).hom s ∈
+          A.cartierIdeal.ideal W := by
+      rw [← A.cartierIdeal.map_ideal (U := W) (V := U)
+        (show W.1 ≤ U.1 from inf_le_left)]
+      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hs
+    rw [A.cartierIdeal_ideal_eq_sectionIdeal_of_le j W inf_le_right] at hsW
+    have hzW : z ∈ W.1 := ⟨hz, hzj⟩
+    have := hsW z hzW
+    rw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply] at this
+    exact this
+  · have hlocal : ∀ x : U.1, ∃ (j : D.index) (r : Γ(relCurve C R, U.1))
+        (rj : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)),
+        (relCurve C R).basicOpen r = (relCurve C R).basicOpen rj ∧
+          x.1 ∈ (relCurve C R).basicOpen r := by
+      intro ⟨x, hxU⟩
+      obtain ⟨j, hxj⟩ := D.exists_mem_pieces x
+      exact ⟨j, exists_basicOpen_le_affine_inter U.2 (D.isAffineOpen j) x ⟨hxU, hxj⟩⟩
+    choose j r rj hr hx using hlocal
+    have hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range r) = ⊤ := by
+      rw [← U.2.self_le_iSup_basicOpen_iff]
+      exact fun x hxU ↦
+        Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨_, ⟨x, hxU⟩, rfl⟩, hx ⟨x, hxU⟩⟩
+    have inst := U.2.isLocalization_basicOpen
+    refine Submodule.le_of_isLocalized_span _ hspan
+      (fun q ↦ Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen q.1))
+      (fun q ↦ Algebra.linearMap Γ(relCurve C R, U.1)
+        Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen q.1)) ?_
+    rintro ⟨_, x, rfl⟩
+    simp +instances only [← Submodule.restrictScalars_localized'
+      Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen (r x)),
+      Ideal.localized'_eq_map, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
+    erw [A.cartierIdeal.map_ideal
+      (U := ⟨_, U.2.basicOpen (r x)⟩) ((relCurve C R).basicOpen_le (r x))]
+    have hpiece : (relCurve C R).basicOpen (r x) ≤ D.pieces (j x) := by
+      rw [hr x]
+      exact (relCurve C R).basicOpen_le (rj x)
+    rw [A.cartierIdeal_ideal_eq_sectionIdeal_of_le (j x)
+      ⟨_, U.2.basicOpen (r x)⟩ hpiece]
+    exact d.map_sectionIdeal_le ((relCurve C R).basicOpen_le (r x))
+
+end AffAdaptation
+
+namespace Scheme.LocalEquations
+
+/-- On a proper relative curve, the germwise section ideals commute with localization to
+affine basic opens. -/
+theorem sectionIdeal_map_ideal_basicOpen [IsProper C.hom]
+    (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) (U : (relCurve C R).affineOpens)
+    (f : Γ(relCurve C R, U.1)) :
+    Ideal.map ((relCurve C R).presheaf.map
+      (homOfLE ((relCurve C R).basicOpen_le f)).op).hom (d.sectionIdeal U.1) =
+      d.sectionIdeal ((relCurve C R).affineBasicOpen f).1 := by
+  obtain ⟨D, ⟨A⟩⟩ := exists_affAdaptation_of_isProper C R d
+  rw [← A.cartierIdeal_ideal_eq_sectionIdeal_affine U,
+    ← A.cartierIdeal_ideal_eq_sectionIdeal_affine
+      ((relCurve C R).affineBasicOpen f)]
+  exact A.cartierIdeal.map_ideal_basicOpen U f
+
+/-- The intrinsic Cartier ideal sheaf cut out by a local-equation divisor on a proper
+relative curve. -/
+noncomputable def cartierIdealData [IsProper C.hom]
+    (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) : (relCurve C R).IdealSheafData where
+  ideal U := d.sectionIdeal U.1
+  map_ideal_basicOpen := d.sectionIdeal_map_ideal_basicOpen
+
+@[simp]
+theorem cartierIdealData_ideal [IsProper C.hom]
+    (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) (U : (relCurve C R).affineOpens) :
+    d.cartierIdealData.ideal U = d.sectionIdeal U.1 :=
+  rfl
+
+/-- The intrinsic Cartier ideal sheaf is invariant under divisor equality. -/
+theorem cartierIdealData_eq_of_divEq [IsProper C.hom]
+    {d₁ d₂ : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations} (h : d₁.DivEq d₂) :
+    d₁.cartierIdealData = d₂.cartierIdealData := by
+  apply Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext
+  funext U
+  exact sectionIdeal_eq_of_divEq h U.1
+
+end Scheme.LocalEquations
+
+namespace AffAdaptation
+
+/-- The intrinsic Cartier ideal sheaf agrees with the ideal sheaf constructed from every
+widened affine adaptation. -/
+theorem cartierIdealData_eq_cartierIdeal [IsProper C.hom]
+    (A : AffAdaptation D d) : d.cartierIdealData = A.cartierIdeal := by
+  apply Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext_of_iSup_eq_top
+    (fun j : D.index ↦ ⟨D.pieces j, D.isAffineOpen j⟩) D.cover
+  intro j
+  exact (A.cartierIdeal_ideal_eq_sectionIdeal j).symm
+
+end AffAdaptation
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry
